question: In November 2024, the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) launched India’s inaugural analog space mission at __________ with an aim to simulate interplanetary habitat conditions and helping scientists explore the feasibility of establishing a sustainable base station beyond Earth.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Leh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **November 2024**, the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)** launched India’s **inaugural analog space mission** in **Leh**, **Ladakh**.
 
• The mission is a collaborative effort involving **ISRO’s Human Space Flight Centre (HSFC)**, **Aakaar Space**, the **University of Ladakh**, **IIT Bombay**, and the **Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council (LAHDC)**.
 
• The primary objective of this mission is to simulate **interplanetary habitat conditions**, providing a controlled environment to study the challenges of living on the **Moon** or **Mars**.
 
• The mission aims to explore the feasibility of establishing a **sustainable base station** beyond **Earth** by testing life support systems, resource management, and communication protocols.
 
• **Leh** was selected as the site for this mission because its **geographical** and **climatic features**—including high altitude, low oxygen levels, extreme cold, and barren landscape—closely mimic the **lunar and martian environments**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Analog Space Missions:**
 
 
• These are field tests conducted in locations on **Earth** that have physical similarities to extreme **space environments**.
 
• They are used to test **robotics**, **habitats**, **spacesuits**, and **human psychology** in isolation before actual spaceflight.
 
• International agencies like **NASA** and **ESA** conduct similar missions in locations like **Antarctica** and the **Atacama Desert**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Ladakh for Space Research:**
 
 
• Known as a **cold desert**, **Ladakh** offers unique **geological analogs** for **Mars**, specifically its volcanic rocks and permafrost.
 
• The **low atmospheric pressure** and **low humidity** in **Leh** provide an ideal setting to test the durability of **spacecraft materials**.
 
 
 
• **ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation):**
 
 
• Founded on **August 15, 1969**, and headquartered in **Bengaluru**.
 
• **ISRO** is currently working on the **Gaganyaan** mission, which is **India’s** first human spaceflight program.
 
• The organisation has also planned the **Bharatiya Antariksh Station** (Indian Space Station), targeted for completion by **2035**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **In-Situ Resource Utilization (ISRU):** One of the mission's focuses is **ISRU**, which involves learning how to use local materials (like lunar regolith) to **construct structures** or produce **oxygen** and **water**.
 
• **Human Factors:** The mission tracks the **circadian rhythms**, **mental health**, and **physical health** of participants living in a confined **analog habitat**.
 
• **Future Prospects:** Successful data from the **Leh analog mission** will contribute to the design of the **habitat modules** for **India's** future missions to the **Moon** under the **Chandrayaan** program.
